Focus Indicators CSS for Shiny Apps

Source: R/ro_shiny_focus_style.R
ro_shiny_focus_style.Rd

Provides CSS for focus indicators on all interactive elements in Shiny apps. Ensures keyboard users can see which element currently has focus, improving accessibility and keyboard navigation.

Usage

ro_shiny_focus_style()

Value

A shiny.tags object (HTML

tag) to be included at the top of your Shiny UI.

See also

ro_shiny_skip_link, ro_shiny_skip_link_style, ro_shiny_button_theme, ro_shiny_dt_responsive

Other shiny: ro_shiny_button_theme(), ro_shiny_dt_responsive(), ro_shiny_screenreader(), ro_shiny_skip_link(), ro_shiny_skip_link_style()

Examples

if (interactive()) {
  ui <- fluidPage(
    ro_shiny_screenreader(),
    ro_shiny_skip_link(),
    ro_shiny_skip_link_style(),
    ro_shiny_focus_style(),
    ro_shiny_button_theme(),
    ro_shiny_dt_responsive(),
    # ... your app UI ...
  )
  server <- function(input, output, session) {}
  shinyApp(ui, server)
}
